mapper.select: SELECT tic.* FROM ai_agent_tool atl LEFT JOIN ai_tool_info_config tic ON atl.tool_info_config_id = tic.id WHERE atl.agent_id = #{agentId} AND atl.agent_config_id = #{agentConfigId} AND atl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND atl.status = 1 AND atl.deleted = 0 AND tic.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tic.enabled = 1 AND tic.deleted = 0
